description: Declared mutants of v8-tool-model-viewer-core and v8-engine-render-offscreen (docs/tools/plans/v8/model-viewer.md, '-core' the 'ro-' ids, and v8-engine-sdl-renderer-texture, the 'rt-' ids, and v8-tool-model-viewer-preview, the 'mvp-' ids (mvp-stale-frame needs a GPU), v8-tool-model-viewer-events, the 'mve-' ids, and v8-tool-model-viewer-event-sounds, the 'mvs-' ids; the offscreen ones need a GPU: Metal on macOS, Lavapipe on Linux; the rt-imgui ones need a tree with the ImGui binding, such as GYO_TOOLS=ui_editor;model_viewer), run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/tools/plans/v8/scripts/model_viewer_mutations.json --build-dir <a tree with GYO_TOOLS=model_viewer and BUILD_TESTING=ON>. A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message. Mutants marked 'not declared' were added while implementing or after the review, beyond the declaration. mv-info-without-binding runs the CLI test through ctest in build/target/_build/mv; give that tree as --build-dir. Test-case filters must not contain commas: doctest splits -tc on commas, and a filter that matches nothing passes.
